description: Find upcoming events (concerts, comedy, theatre, sports, family shows, festivals) near a US ZIP code, a city or coordinates, filtered by dates, categories (Music, Sports, Arts & Theatre, Film, Miscellaneous, or genres such as Jazz or Comedy), keywords, artist, venue and maximum price. Returns events with local date, time zone, venue, published price range (null means not published, never free), ticket link, provenance, freshness and coverage limits. Sources: Ticketmaster, plus SeatGeek when enabled on this server; each event names its source (SeatGeek events say "Event data from SeatGeek"; credit it). SeatGeek resale_market prices are listed resale prices, not face value. The same event on both sources is shown once, with the other link under other_listings. Coverage varies by country; say so when results are thin. Never invent events beyond the results.
name: search_local_events
title: Search local events
